integrity: Symbolic gap proof and six-sector limit argument; finite tests corroborate but cannot establish all-length statements. The limits are not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: The results concern exactly three ones, ordered alphabet 0<1, linear contiguous distinct Lyndon factors and fixed-content sampling. Literature priority remains qualified: the 2017 unrestricted extremal work covers the fixed-content maximum; no new maximum is claimed. One 2004 related paper was not fully accessible.
title: Complete three-marker distribution of distinct Lyndon factors
